data.rule_evidence_reference: Synthetic demo per docs/br/br_01_climate-condition-monitoring.md §4.1/§7: delta_temp 0.5 °C and delta_co2 50 ppm applied to BOTH the requested and realized bases; explicitly NOT an agronomic-standard AGC threshold and not derived from the setpoint dictionary. Registration boundary follows the approved T14 schedule semantics (one segment mode, at most one revision per requested metric key; historical revisions stay replayable).
